items.title: Potassium binder may ease the burden of dietary potassium restriction in people on dialysis
items.text: Dietary potassium restriction is important for managing hyperkalemia, or high blood potassium levels, in individuals on maintenance hemodialysis, but it imposes a substantial day-to-day burden. Results from a recent clinical trial indicate that adding the potassium binder sodium zirconium cyclosilicate (SZC) may help. The findings will be presented at ASN Kidney Week 2026, Oct. 22–25.

items.title: Fruits and vegetables outperform medication for treating metabolic acidosis in chronic kidney disease
items.text: In people with chronic kidney disease (CKD), oral sodium bicarbonate is a standard treatment for metabolic acidosis (too much acid buildup in the body), but results from a recent clinical trial indicate that dietary acid reduction with base-producing fruits and vegetables may be a better option. The findings will be presented at ASN Kidney Week 2026, Oct. 22–25.
